items.title: GLM-Legal: A New AI Model for Legal Text Generation
items.summary: The GLM-Legal model has been introduced to enhance legal text generation, providing a specialized tool for legal professionals. This development is significant as it aims to improve efficiency and accuracy in legal document drafting.

items.title: Making Big Downloads Resumable in Firefox
items.summary: A new feature in Firefox allows users to resume large downloads, enhancing user experience and reducing data wastage. This is particularly important for developers and users in regions with unstable internet connections.

items.title: Hackers Activate Automatic Defrosting in Supermarket Fridges Across Europe
items.summary: A significant cyberattack has compromised supermarket fridges across Europe, activating automatic defrosting and impacting food safety and supply chains. This incident highlights the vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure and the need for improved cybersecurity measures.

items.title: Codex CLI Installs a Persistent, Self-Updating Background Daemon by Default
items.summary: The Codex CLI has been updated to include a persistent background daemon that updates itself automatically, raising concerns about user control and security. Developers should be aware of this change as it could affect how they manage their environments.

items.title: Turn a WiFi 7 Router into a 320Msps Software Defined Radio Receiver
items.summary: A new project allows developers to repurpose a WiFi 7 router into a high-speed software-defined radio receiver, showcasing innovative uses of existing hardware. This development opens up new possibilities for signal processing and telecommunications research.
